scope: Primary public TM Forum, UK operator and telecom vendor sources. Observed examples inform proposed reusable rules; they are not universal operator requirements.

sources.title: TMF620 Product Catalog v5 OpenAPI
sources.supports: Offering terms, price periods, validity, specification characteristics and relationships. These fields do not constitute a complete executable rule engine.

sources.title: TMF633 Service Catalog v4 OpenAPI
sources.supports: Service specification characteristics and dependency, substitution or exclusivity relationships.

sources.title: TMF760 Product Configuration Management v5
sources.supports: Configuration uses catalogue, policy and product inventory data; it restricts characteristics, bundle option counts, prices and discounts.

sources.title: TMF679 Product Offering Qualification Management v5
sources.supports: Commercial eligibility, distinct from technical service feasibility.

sources.title: TMFC009 Service Qualification v1.1.1
sources.supports: Identifies a feasible RFS solution and checks resource availability without allocating resources.

sources.title: SID Product Specification and CFS realization
sources.supports: Specifications are templates; products can realize shared CFS specifications supported by RFS specifications.

sources.title: Salesforce Industries CPQ rules interfaces
sources.supports: Rules for availability, eligibility, pricing, and require/recommend/exclude relationships. This is vendor guidance, not a TM Forum mandate.

sources.title: EE Short Terms
sources.supports: Speed and roaming policies, plan/device eligibility, allowance expiry and sharing exclusions.
sources.limitations: Version and cohort matter. This page states a 100GB giftable amount while the gifting help page distinguishes 120GB for 5G and 100GB for 4G; treat the discrepancy as requiring source review.

sources.title: EE Data Gifting help
sources.supports: Account-holder control, same-account lines, immediate transfer, monthly reset and recipient roaming terms.
sources.limitations: Do not turn an operator-specific or conflicting giftable cap into a global default.

sources.title: Vodafone UK SIM-only plans
sources.supports: 30-day/12-/24-month options, dated future GBP monthly prices, allowance and plan-tier variants.
sources.limitations: Promotional tiles can vary by channel, session and offer cohort. Capture the selected offer and terms rather than ingest a search snippet as a tariff.

sources.title: Vodafone OneNumber
sources.supports: Eligible primary airtime plan, compatible cellular companion device, shared allowances, device-specific roaming, MMS restrictions and inherited bars.

sources.title: Vodafone Spend Manager
sources.supports: Spend limits cover specified usage classes, with exclusions such as purchased Extras and some account charges.

sources.title: Lebara UK SIM-only plans
sources.supports: Operator example of no annual price hikes and different contract/allowance variants.
sources.limitations: The page requires JavaScript when opened; indexed official page content was available. Verify selected terms before publication.

sources.title: Lebara UK Help
sources.supports: Auto-renewal depends on balance; switching and cancellation depend on expiry and auto-renewal settings.

sources.title: Lyca National Plus
sources.supports: Promotion windows, new-customer/channel restrictions, activation deadline, included destination types and add-on expiry.
sources.limitations: On 24 October 2026, the visible half-price promotion's terms ended on 23 October 2026. Treat it as expired even if the banner remains visible; it is evidence for a rule pattern, not a current available offer.

sources.title: EE End of Plan
sources.supports: Commitment ending can move a service to a rolling plan rather than disconnect it.

sources.title: EE Cancellation and Remaining Contract Charges
sources.supports: Remaining-term cancellation and notice charges depend on the customer's contract and effective termination date.

sources.title: Ofcom guidance on telecoms price rises
sources.supports: New UK consumer contracts from 17 January 2025 must disclose scheduled core-subscription increases in pounds and pence and their timing. Older contracts and business cohorts require their own rules.

sources.title: Ericsson 5GS roaming architecture
sources.supports: Subscriber roaming restrictions can distinguish permitted services; 5G roaming involves subscription and policy functions.

sources.title: GSMA TS.43 Service Entitlement Configuration
sources.supports: Companion subscription entitlement and on-device eSIM activation are additional to allowance sharing.
